Builds on macOS with Apple's libc++, plus layout and stability fixes.
Same API as 0.1.3.

### Fixes

- The public headers no longer use the floating-point `std::from_chars`,
  which Apple's libc++ does not provide: including `<rtxui/rtxui.hpp>`
  failed to compile there, as in the xmake package on macOS.
- Whitespace in templates follows CSS: a line break between text and an
  element is a space (`A,` then `<s>B</s>` on the next line reads "A, B",
  not "A,B"), runs of spaces collapse to one under `white-space: normal`,
  and spaces at the start and end of a line are dropped.
- A component destroyed while one of its children still ran a timer (an
  open `<toast>`, say) no longer has the child write to it afterwards, which
  could crash.
- Resizing the terminal no longer flashes a blank screen: the clear now
  happens inside the synchronized update.

### Examples

- `elements`: every built-in element, one page each, next to the HTML that
  draws it.

### Packages

| File | What it holds |
| :--- | :--- |
| `rtxui-0.1.4-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Debug and Release static libraries, headers, CMake package, pkg-config file |
| `rtxui-0.1.4-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | The same, for arm64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.4-macos-universal.tar.gz` | The same, for arm64 and x86_64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.4-windows-x64.zip` | The same, built with MSVC (`/MD` runtime; `rtxuid.lib` for Debug) |
| `rtxui-0.1.4-windows-arm64.zip` | The same, for arm64 |
| `rtxui-0.1.4-windows-x64-mingw.zip` | The same, built with MinGW-w64 GCC, UCRT, as MSYS2's UCRT64 |
| `librtxui-dev_0.1.4_amd64.deb`, `librtxui-dev_0.1.4_arm64.deb` | Release library for Debian and Ubuntu |
| `rtxui-devel-0.1.4-1.x86_64.rpm`, `rtxui-devel-0.1.4-1.aarch64.rpm` | Release library for Fedora and other RPM distributions |
| `rtxui-0.1.4.tar.gz` | The source, as committed |

Before publishing, the release installs each .deb on Ubuntu 24.04 and each
.rpm on Fedora, and builds an app against each archive with
`find_package(rtxui)`, in Debug and in Release.

A prebuilt static C++ library links with a compatible compiler and standard
library: GCC or Clang with libstdc++ on Linux, Apple Clang on macOS, MSVC or
MinGW (UCRT) on Windows, each with its own archive. Otherwise, build from
source with FetchContent, as described in
[Getting started](https://arthursonzogni.github.io/RTXUI/guide/getting-started).
